name: Camping Stein
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Stein is located in Bad Endorf in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The surrounding area is characterized by mountains and extensive nature. Nearby are several ski areas as well as hiking trails of varying difficulty. The site itself offers a quiet atmosphere and is equipped with sanitary facilities and power connections. A small shop and a common room complete the amenities. Guests use the campsite as a base for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and mountain tours. The facility is suitable for travelers seeking nature-oriented accommodation.
